title: Elderly Couple Walking Down Wedding Aisle, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing an elderly couple walking arm-in-arm down a carpeted aisle during an indoor formal ceremony or wedding reception. The man wears a dark suit, boutonniere, and a white kippah (yarmulke), while the woman wears a dark dress with a lace collar, corsage, pearl necklace, and mid-century cat-eye glasses. A large white floral display adorned with ribbon stands prominent in the foreground.
